intro.title: Quarter in Review
intro.subtitle: A digital report for service offering leaders that provides visibility into their offering's readiness, financial performance, and consultant usage.

meta.label: Goal
meta.text: The report aimed to provide service offering leaders an adoptable experience that would motivate them to improve the quality of their offering.

meta.label: Outcomes
meta.text: Within two quarters, the report scaled from 1 offering to 28 offerings and received high engagement with offering teams.

meta.label: Role
meta.text: I co-designed this report with another UX designer and my biggest contribution to the project was its user interface and data visualizations.

meta.label: Client and scope
meta.text: The internal client for this project was IBM Services Offering Management and lasted for 6 weeks in early 2020.

context.question: How might we design a better way for offering leaders to manage their offering's lifecycle?
points: Offering leaders lacked reliable, accessible data to make evidence-based decisions and continually improve their offerings.
The data that did exist was fragmented across platforms and inconsistently formatted, breeding mistrust among offering teams.
Offering leaders often lacked the skills and dedicated time to manage their offering's ongoing performance.
The vision was a quarterly report with the right information, at the right density, to help leaders maintain and evolve high-quality offerings.
